title: Eraser deletes the entire shape instead of vector-subtracting along the eraser path
description:
FIXED. Implemented Flash 8 vector erase (boolean SUBTRACT along the eraser path) instead of whole-object delete.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed firsthand): StageArea.tsx eraser pointer-move handler did a circle-vs-AABB hit test and called onShapeDelete(obj.id) -> removeDisplayObject (whole-object removal). packages/core/src/engine/shape-boolean.ts shapeBoundsSubtract() was a documented stub ('returns A unchanged'); no real polygon clipping existed.

FIX (where the subtract lives):
- NEW pure/testable core module packages/core/src/engine/eraser.ts:
  * buildEraserPolygon(points, radius) -> eraser stamp loops (per-sample disk + bridging capsule rect; not pre-unioned).
  * subtractPolygon(subject, clip) -> real polygon boolean SUBTRACT via a compact Greiner-Hormann (CCW-normalized inputs, degeneracy perturbation, containment fallbacks for disjoint/full-cover/hole). Returns 0 loops (fully erased), 1 (reshaped), or N (split/hole).
  * eraseShape(shape, eraserLoops, opts) -> applies the subtract per ShapePath (fills + strokes), returns new Shape or null (fully covered). Flattens quadratic beziers to fine polylines for the cut (Flash also produces a polygonal cut edge).
  Exported from engine/index.ts (buildEraserPolygon, subtractPolygon, eraseShape).
- Two GH correctness bugs found & fixed during impl: (1) entry/exit convention for difference; (2) re-reading c.next inside the intersection loop after insertion shortened edges and dropped the 2nd crossing on an edge (a band cutting clean through a rect found 3 crossings not 4) -> now capture original edge endpoints in a Map before any insertion.
- StageArea.tsx eraser handler (ERASER region only, no text-edit path touched): per move, build the swept eraser polygon, inverse-transform into each overlapping shape's LOCAL space (stageToShapeLocal helper), eraseShape(); onShapeUpdate with reduced geometry, or onShapeDelete only when subtraction removes the entire shape.

TESTS: packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/eraser.test.ts (16 tests, all pass) — incl. ACCEPTANCE: erasing PART of a filled rect keeps the shape (not null) with reduced/split geometry; erasing a circle from the middle -> outer+hole loops; drag cuts a wide rect into 2 pieces; full cover -> null. Build green; @flash/core 5318 pass / 2 fail (both pre-existing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla ENOENT, untracked binary — unrelated); @flash/authoring-ui 668/668 pass.
